strong-ionization.alt: Left: four HCl molecules put in water become four hydronium ions and four chloride ions, with no HCl molecules left, because a strong acid ionizes completely. Right: mixing 0.0050 mol hydronium with 0.0030 mol hydroxide leaves 0.0020 mol hydronium in 0.0500 L, 0.040 M, pH 1.40.
